post.description:
Creates a durable support ticket without sending email or WhatsApp messages. Requires Idempotency-Key; retries return the original response. Linking a conversation also requires conversations:read.

Required scope: `tickets:write`. Required product: `desk`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique key for a ticket creation (1–128 visible ASCII characters). Retained for the company's lifetime. Reusing a key with a different request returns 409; identical retries return the original 201 response.

example.subject: Customer cannot sign in
example.description: A support request synchronized from our CRM.
